name: Owner and banking View Document links open the stored owner and bank documents
description:
Objective: Owner and banking View Document links open the stored owner and bank documents.
Preconditions: Open Document access with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Document access.
2. Owner and banking View Document links open the stored owner and bank documents.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Checks every converted record (up to three): the link must work for each.
